title: Add opt-in source-pin history preflight before publication
body:
## Summary

```diff
 check_research_commit.py --package research/example
   compare working/publication bytes
+  --check-source-history
+    read committed SOURCES.json
+    require every declared source commit in publication ancestry
```

Add an opt-in preflight for the cached-foreign-commit failure that broke cold CI in PR3234 and PR3227. The default byte check and shared replay runner are unchanged. Separate branches, replacement objects and legacy grafts cannot supply publication ancestry. Shallow history fails closed.

Changed files are the preflight, twelve regression tests and its package-guide documentation. Existing pins, source bytes, scientific assertions and selected frontier are unchanged. This is verifier engineering under `portable-replay`, not a mathematical improvement or a new kappa.

## Evidence

- **Before:** a valid pin to an unrelated cached commit passes byte-only preflight. Packing only the publication's reachable objects omits that commit.
  **After:** the opt-in CLI rejects it without printing PASS or changing the checkout. Ancestor pins pass the cold object-only fixture. All synthetic fixtures are created locally without project clones or remote objects.
- The history checker rejects original PR3234 head `bd90899d5a45806288f7f3c9f177172a0ef5fa59` and original PR3227 head `2a79c8314ae10b677bc7c1dd593d0c3d06b7cd15`, then accepts their repaired heads `7e1de0fd19040f7de20b06a14313e228f9a01280` and `dea1160da81edfc3edf5204e70a895475c256454`. This is a provenance regression, not another mathematical replay.
- CPython 3.12.15 on Linux, Git 2.47.3: all 265 onboarding tests pass with 11 Windows-only skips; the twelve new tests also pass with optimized Python and warnings-as-errors. Ruff and whitespace checks pass. The real CLI accepts the unchanged `selected-form-construction-storage` package. Hosted CI remains a separate obligation until settled on this exact head.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py' -v
python3.12 -O -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_source_history.py' -v
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py \
  --package research/selected-form-construction-storage --check-source-history
```

Limits: this checks declared Git-history availability, not full metadata validity, script-embedded pins, explicit external fetches, transitive imports, LFS payloads, dependencies or mathematics. Cold supplier replay, native/caller admission, human review and proof-kernel verification are not claimed. The guide records resource bounds and Open next questions.

Base canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6, refetched unchanged before publication. Submission overlap covered 348 open PRs and 2,147 Discussion records with complete pagination through 21:20 UTC; arbitrary diffs, closed and unpublished work are not exhausted. No Discussion comments were posted under the communication restriction.

Credit the existing publication-byte preflight by ywz65, Douglas Colkitt's source-pin contract and the retained PR3234/3227 repair/source lineage. The change preserves their attribution. Build the Lever led to a reusable check instead of another manual repair; Prove It Works led to the actual CLI and cold-object controls. Power of Ten led to bounded metadata and per-query timeouts, without a fixed-heap claim.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** opt-in

Only an explicitly requested publication check gains stricter ancestry requirements. Intentional external dependencies can keep their explicit fetch contracts without using this stricter flag. No source manifest or shared replay workflow is modified.
